text:
If you wait until tonight, the 2-hour window will have closed (you'd be about 5 hours 20 minutes after ordering). You then couldn't change the order online.

- **Asking support:** Support can try to intercept the order before it ships and add the pot, but that isn't guaranteed. Chat runs 8am-8pm Mon-Sat in your local time. Email (help@leafy.example) is answered within 1 business day, which might be too slow.
- **Shipping timing:** Live plants ship Monday-Wednesday only, so your order may still be waiting to ship. I can't promise it will be, though, so don't count on it.
- **A separate order:** You can place a new order for the pot. It would ship separately from the ZZ plant. Standard shipping is $7.95, free if that order is $75 or more after discounts.

If you want the pot on the same order, the safest option is to add it from "My Orders" within the next 1 hour 40 minutes or so.
